input.text:
[conversational] Here's the original shot, and here's the AI edit.

[relaxed] The car looks good, but the framing has shifted a little. PlateLock lines it back up.

You load both clips in ComfyUI, check the match, and run the repair.

Then, with an LTX mask, you can keep the new car and bring back the original background.

For timing, we made a test with nine missing frames and two repeats. PlateLock matches the sequence, and RIFE fills the gaps.

[relaxed] That's PlateLock. The AI edit, lined up with your original shot.

ltx_alpha.execution: Native Windows ComfyUI; external finishing workflow

garage_composite_finishing.scope: Shot-specific external finishing after actual PlateLock alignment. Parameters in pixels at 1920x1080; not an automatic change detector.
garage_composite_finishing.reflection_patches: Select small red/amber source-floor reflections below the cars; dilate 9px and feather with sigma 7px.
garage_composite_finishing.background_colour_match: Linear BT.709 difference field estimated outside both car masks and affected floor, with a 32px exclusion border. Weighted Gaussian smoothing at 320x180, sigma 12; temporal EMA 0.65 previous + 0.35 current. Apply only to background replacement patches, preserving the new car colour.
garage_composite_finishing.composite: Blend matched background patches into original plate, then overlay new car. Copy protected source pixels exactly before encoding.
